scope: Four-pulse isolated encounters using real server weapons/movement and ordinary fixed input vectors. Distances are emitter-to-body-center world units. Reaction begins at visible locked charge, plus specified latency. Flank follows a fixed path to the builder. Other traffic, body contacts, collection, inhale and rival attacks are excluded; reaching the builder is access, not a claimed kill. Actual bot sample uses the normal imperfect decision brain with fixed seeds. Not human fun/fairness proof.
